profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ SpaceX
profile.summary: Motivated Computer Science candidate with a focus on software engineering. Seeking to leverage skills in collaboration, communication and computational analyses. Proven leader with meticulous attention to detail throughout solving complex problems. Strong analytical mindset with a track record of consistently meeting project deadlines under fast-paced environments.

positions.title: IAM and Cyber Operations Intern
positions.description:
• Built custom forms, workflows and scripts utilizing PowerShell, JavaScript, and REST API calls to automate business processes and account provisioning, decreasing the time to complete tickets by more than 90%
• Acted as a team lead over 8 interns, supporting and managing them to complete 19 cloud automation projects
• Mapped over 50 business applications and services managed by the IAM team to centralize the automation, management, and maintenance of more than 400 servers in a ServiceNow configuration management database
positions.insights: Skills: ServiceNow · Powershell · REST APIs · Identity Panel · Identity and Access Management (IAM)

positions.title: ECS Scholars Mentor
positions.description:
• Lead 2 mentees through a series of one-on-one meetings designed with their academic success in mind
• Provide mentees with support and an experienced resource as they navigate through their first year of college
• Attend monthly group seminars to better engage with mentees on a specific topic relating to their success

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Conducted a systematic literature review of 562 scholarly papers to better understand current methods to dynamically construct a holistic visualization of microservice-based systems and the gaps in these practices
• Published a 15-page research paper to the IEEE Access journal detailing and synthesizing the findings of the literature review which has over 700 reads and 3 citations in academia (doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2022.3221130)
• Developed a JavaScript prototype to provide a high-level visualization of microservice-based systems in an interactive 2-dimensional or 3-dimensional space using a JSON-based architectural description of the system
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Go (Programming Language) · HTML · React.js · JavaScript · REST APIs

positions.title: Counselor
positions.description:
• Led area groups to manage and create a fun atmosphere for children from 6 to 18 years old while leading them through activities that provided an exciting and entertaining way to bring them closer to Christ in their lives
• Served on work crew to tear down and set up for 17 meals a week and ensure that mealtimes were enjoyable experiences for the campers where they could be served and not have to lift a finger for any of their needs
• Managed over 20 activity classes to engage and teach youth and create a fun but safe environment for them

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Operated the $200,000 Bolt High-Speed Camera Robot and the $50,000 8K Red Digital Cinema camera to record and produce 100s of shots that gave life to various products through intentional and detail-oriented planning
• Built over 6 different circuits and programmed electronics for precise movements and time-sensitive switches
• Assisted management with 7 commercial productions to produce innovative shots to aid clients’ marketing
• Researched and 3D-printed equipment to aid video production by allowing for new functionality in our shots
positions.insights: Skills: Digital Cinema · FLAIR Motion Control

honors.title: Patrick J. Keane Award for Outstanding Computer Science Senior

projects.title: MicroProspect Visualization Tool
projects.description: This three-dimensional visualization of a microservice-based system can highlight anti-patterns within the system and shows system evolution through a timeline of the system, displaying the architecture at every commit. In addition, resource utilization by services within the system can also be visualized.

projects.title: Cloud-Native Systems Visualization POC
projects.description: This architecture visualization proof-of-concept aims to provide an interactive visualization framework for cloud-native systems. Currently, the web-based application takes a JSON file describing the microservice-based system in the abstract terms of nodes and links and generates a high-level 2D and 3D perspective of the system. The resulting perspectives are highly customizable and interactive to allow for control over the holistic system view.

publications.title: Visualizing Microservice Architecture in the Dynamic Perspective: A Systematic Mapping Study
